note: XXVII cue 97: the mark leaves Mina's forehead in a wisp of dense white smoke (Ian)

beats.text: On the young woman's forehead, just above the brows, add a small burn scar in the shape of an upright cross, dark red, already fading and dissolving: from it a thin wisp of dense white smoke curls upward and away into the red sunset air, carrying the mark off. Keep her face, hair, light and the background exactly as they are, and soften the tears on her cheeks so none are streaming.
